label_note: Labels are strategy-derived PROXY labels from a transparent breakout rule: NOT human demonstrations.

label_definition.outcome: executable return from open t+1 to open t+1+horizon plus closes back through the broken level; purged at split boundaries

confidence_definition: temperature-calibrated probability of the chosen action after masking invalid actions; calibrated against the training labels, not against breakout success
execution_convention: decision at close of bar t, fill at open of bar t+1
decision_time_bars: reference ranges use bars t-N..t-1; volume surge uses the previous 20/50 bars; ATR normalisers use the ATR at the close of t-1

shared_schema.note: shared 30-column sequence + 8-dim static identical to the other policies; breakout columns arrive via the adapter

data.source: indian-market-historical-ohlcv.csv (local consolidated Indian-market daily OHLCV; no Yahoo Finance download)
data.price_adjustment: OHLC adjusted by adj_close/close; raw volume retained

intended_use: research and paper trading only; not a recommendation to trade real money
